eyebrow.zh: 账号声线 · 你拥有的资产 · 离线零 key
eyebrow.en: Account voice · Your owned asset · Offline, zero key

headline.zh:
AI 副驾写的正文一眼就是爆款体
voicelock 把它逐句改回你账号的声线
headline.en:
Your AI copilot's draft screams viral slop
voicelock rewrites it sentence by sentence into your voice

sub.zh: 从你自己的往期笔记学出账号声线指纹，再逐句检测爆款体区域、在声线内重写、回检达标——退火掉『姐妹们/绝绝子/感叹号轰炸』，改回你本人的表达。
sub.en: It learns an account voiceprint from your own past posts, then detects slop regions sentence-by-sentence, rewrites them inside your voice, and rechecks until they pass — boiling off the 姐妹们/绝绝子/exclamation-bomb slop back into how you actually write.

scroll.zh: 看看怎么去 AI 味

title.zh: 声线指纹是你拥有的资产
title.en: Your voiceprint is an asset you own

body.zh: 不是又一次『丢给 AI 一个 prompt 让它学我说话』。voicelock 从你自己的往期笔记算出账号声线指纹，存到你本地，是你拥有的资产——跨帖跨天复用，不是一次性 prompt。
body.en: Not another 'give AI a prompt to mimic me.' voicelock learns your account voiceprint from your own past posts and keeps it locally — an asset you own, reusable post after post, not a one-shot prompt.

title.zh: 一眼标出正文里的爆款体区域
title.en: Flags the slop regions in your draft

body.zh: 针对小红书同质化套路——姐妹们、绝绝子、yyds、感叹号轰炸——逐句标出 slop 区域并给分，告诉你哪几句一眼就是爆款体、要改。
body.en: Built for Xiaohongshu's homogenized formulas — 姐妹们, 绝绝子, yyds, exclamation bombs — it flags the slop regions sentence-by-sentence with a score, showing you exactly which lines scream slop and need rewriting.

title.zh: 改回你的声线，回检达标才算完
title.en: Rewritten into your voice — rechecked until it passes

body.zh: 对每个爆款体区域跑『重写 → 回检』：在你的账号声线里重写，重写后回检不达标就再来一轮，不是一次改完就交差。
body.en: Each slop region runs a rewrite → recheck loop: rewritten inside your account's voice, and if the recheck doesn't pass, it goes again — not a single-pass handoff.

title.zh: 零 key 离线，从安装到出结果
title.en: Zero-key, offline — from install to result

body.zh: 默认一个零 API key、不联网的离线后端，从安装到第一条去 AI 味正文全程离线跑通；想要更高质量，带上你自己的模型 key 即可。
body.en: A zero-API-key, offline backend by default — from install to your first de-AI'd draft, the whole chain runs with no key and no network. Want higher quality? Bring your own model key.

headline.zh: 把你的声线变成你拥有的资产
headline.en: Turn your voice into an asset you own

sub.zh: 开源 · Apache-2.0 · 本地一条命令跑通。
sub.en: Open source · Apache-2.0 · runs locally in one command.

tag.zh: 给小红书正文做去 AI 味的账号声线改写
tag.en: Account-voiceprint de-AI rewriting for Xiaohongshu posts
